importPolicy.ui: Use a ui family directly for generic behavior, public compound composition or a primitive without a product contract.
importPolicy.atoms: Use an atom only when its registry entry documents added identity, semantics, accessibility, defaults or reusable product composition.
importPolicy.molecules: Compose ui families and maintained atoms; never reexport or import organisms.
importPolicy.migration: Deprecated aliases remain only for compatibility and are not valid new consumer paths.
